verdict.rationale: Kit's API lets an agent create a broadcast as a draft or scheduled send targeted at segment or tag IDs. The official Kit MCP exposes broadcasts and segments for read and write, and lists prompts like 'draft a broadcast to my new subscribers' as real account actions. The draft state can act as a queue for a human, but no explicit approval gate or review step is documented. Missing for 10: a documented human-approval/review workflow before send, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent-draft-then-approve flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can draft a campaign against a segment and leave it scheduled or queued for a human to approve before send

citations.quote: Draft or schedule to send a broadcast to all or a subset of your subscribers... We currently support targeting your subscribers based on segment or tag ids.
The Kit MCP is a remote MCP server that exposes a creator's Kit account — subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, segments, and more — to MCP-compatible AI clients.
Natural-language prompts like “draft a broadcast to my new subscribers from this week” become real account actions.
Update an existing broadcast. Continue to draft or schedule to send a broadcast to all or a subset of your subscribers.
